profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer - MATLAB Datatypes at MathWorks

positions.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
positions.description:
Constructed a global dataset of over 600 million hourly surface ozone observations from all publicly-available scientific and regulatory data.
Developed automated quality-control algorithms for processing the data.
Developed chemistry, regulatory, and statistical metrics for assessing ozone in chemistry-climate models, providing the first global dataset for the CCMI/HTAP modeling communities.
Corresponded with more than 100 international data providers (WMO, NOAA, CSIRO, etc.) regarding fair use and publication of their measurements. 
Assessed current extent of data coverage and optimal expansion of the global observing network using techniques including trend, cluster, and spectral analysis.
Used dataset to rapidly assess impact of metrology changes on air quality policy. Seven days from initial idea to a submitted manuscript.
Advisory role with three PhD students in the group.
Developed and taught research project skills course for Masters students with theme ``Atmospheric Chemistry of Climate Catastrophes'' (Spring 2015).

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Used ice core measurements of the oxygen isotopes of sulfate and nitrate to constrain atmospheric chemistry models of past sulfate and nitrate formation pathways and atmospheric oxidant abundances on glacial to interglacial and preindustrial to present-day timescales.
Ran and modified the GEOS-Chem global chemical transport model and Matlab-based box model of sulfate chemistry; implemented Monte Carlo simulations in box model.
Continuous-flow gas-chromatography isotope-ratio mass spectrometry measurements of the triple-oxygen isotopes of nitrate and sulfate.  Method development to reduce ice core sample size required for isotope measurements.
